note: Smoky Lake County campground on the far west side of Hanmore Lake, with a small beach, boat launch and trailer parking, cook shelter and playground. Most sites sit in an open grassy loop; 31-39 are bush sites along the road. The waterfront sites (26-30) are group sites booked for at least 3 units; sites 16-18 have lake views across the road. Firewood, ice and kayak and paddleboard rentals on site. The nearest dump stations and showers are in Smoky Lake. --Claude
